titleEn: Cancel a yearly package and refund unused months

operatorReason.text: merchant cannot cancel/refund a yearly plan themselves; the formula is deterministic (unused whole months x price/12, debt first) so a self-service quote and confirm is feasible, only the card refund execution needs a human

ar: مين بيعمل إلغاء الباقة السنوية واسترداد؟
ليه مش لاقي إلغاء الباقة السنوية واسترداد عندي؟
عايز إلغاء الباقة السنوية واسترداد اكلم مين؟
en: Why can I not do this myself: Cancel a yearly package and refund unused months?

steps: Super admin only; every write re-checks the session (fails closed) and is audited with actor and reason
edgeCases: Assistant refuses and offers the merchant-facing alternative or a handoff to Ebda
gaps: Self-service gap: merchant cannot cancel/refund a yearly plan themselves; the formula is deterministic (unused whole months x price/12, debt first) so a self-service quote and confirm is feasible, only the card refund execution needs a human
operator replaces: packages.yearly-switch (merchant told to write to support)
